status: PRE-REGISTERED confirmatory run of docs/13 amendment A3, hypothesis H8.11 (masked CVTM, the Gate 1 amendment row). Validation split only; the test split is never loaded. The model is deterministic given the data (no seed, docs/13 A3); uncertainty is a document-block bootstrap, labelled derived.
docs: docs/11 section 11.8 (masked variant) and 11.6 (fit documents); docs/12 F20 b (residues) and c (plain EM); docs/13 amendment A3
launch: scripts/gpu_run.sh shared -- scripts/cpu_slot.sh 1 -- nice -n 10 .venv-tm/bin/python scripts/mem_guard.py -- scripts/run_logged.py --name cvtm_H8_11_masked --config experiments/cvtm/configs/H8_11_masked.json -- .venv-tm/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_masked.py --config experiments/cvtm/configs/H8_11_masked.json

data.counting: every position of every document of the full V 8000 train split (135,246,414 tokens, 28,472 documents), only the target itself hidden
data.validation: the frozen validation eval set, subword variant (data/wikitext103/bpe8000/evalsets/validation_subword.npz, loaded with tmlm.data.evalsets.load_evalset, as experiments/e3_wikitext_masked.py and experiments/m2_baselines.py do), under its frozen hidden mask: a hidden token is not visible context
data.evalset_hash_source: results/20260922T180823Z_M2_baselines_ngram_v8000/dataset_hashes.json (the set the comparators were measured on)
data.dataset_hashes: as results/20260923T042350Z_CP_anchor/dataset_hashes.json via tmlm.cvtm.protocol.write_dataset_hashes (train and validation tokens, document starts, validation text and document bytes) plus evalset_validation_subword_V8000 (the key name of the M2 run)

patterns.source: NGRAM_TYPES of experiments/ckm_posthoc_probe.py (asserted equal by tests/test_cvtm_masked.py)
patterns.edge: a position outside the document reads EDGE = V (8000)
patterns.cut: a pattern with any hidden in-document position does not fire (all or nothing, as the context levels of KNModel.contexts)

fit_documents.rule: training document i with mix64(i XOR 0xC0FFEE) mod 100 == 0 (docs/11 11.6, docs/12 F20 b; tmlm.cvtm.protocol)
fit_documents.fit_rows: every position of H (1,397,702 rows), only the row's own target hidden; S read-outs from the counts WITHOUT H (all training counts minus the H counts, exact), unigram without H; the fitted weights are then applied with the counts over ALL training documents (the protocol of docs/11 11.6)

model.s_clauses: S(pattern, u): fires iff the pattern is not cut and its key u occurs at a counting position; read-out the exact successor distribution O(u, c) / N(u) (maximum likelihood, no smoothing, as the probe's lin)
model.d_clauses: D(pattern): fires iff an earlier position q of the same document has the same key, is visible, and its pattern is not cut; the most recent such q votes for tok[q] (point mass); whole-document window. In a fit row, q with 1 <= p - q <= right extent of the pattern is cut (its span covers the hidden target)
model.combination: P(c) = [a0 P_uni(c) + sum over fired S of alpha[pattern, floor(log2 N)] P_u(c) + sum over fired D of beta[pattern] [c = tok[q]]] / (a0 + sum of the fired weights); the normalised linear mixture lin of experiments/ckm_posthoc_probe.py
model.buckets: alpha per (pattern, floor(log2 N)) as docs/11 11.8 states (the probe script grouped by pattern length instead; the spec is followed); N = the context count without H for fit rows and over all training documents for validation; 32 levels per pattern (N < 2**32 asserted)
model.unigram: add-one unigram of the counting positions (without H for the fit rows), weight a0 fitted like every other weight; the mixture is scale free, so the weights are reported scaled so that the largest is 1
model.d_confidence: beta per pattern (10 weights), fitted by the same EM on H as the alpha weights: the reading of 'confidence per pattern from the fit documents' fixed before any run (one fitting procedure for every weight; document clauses also fire where the pattern context never occurs in training, which a per-component hit rate attached to an S clause, as in the probe's induction rows, cannot)
model.unfitted_bucket_rule: an alpha bucket without fit rows takes the weight of the nearest fitted level of the same pattern (the lower level on a tie); a unigram weight without fit rows is an error; a D weight without fit rows is undefined and scoring a row that uses it is an error

em.method: plain minorise-maximise EM (the pooled-weights step of src/tmlm/cvtm/mixture.py, docs/12 F20 c): w_b <- n_b / c_b, then every weight divided by the largest (scale free; keeps the weights finite when the supremum lies on the boundary); float64, single thread, fixed order
em.stop_rule: stop when the mean log-likelihood per fit row gains less than tol in one iteration, or at max_iter; the trace must never decrease (check, 1e-12)
em.budget_calibration: fixed on 2026-09-24 before the logged run from an unlogged smoke on TRAINING documents only (the first 30M training tokens without the documents of residues 7 and 8; 71 fit documents, 312,492 fit rows; the pseudo-evaluation documents are training documents under a synthetic mask), looking only at the EM trace: MM converges linearly with a slow tail; run to 20,000 iterations, the first iteration gaining less than 1e-10 nats per row was 5,200, where the remaining gain to iteration 20,000 was 3.6e-7 nats per row (1e-9: 1,865 iterations, 1.4e-6 remaining) [unverified: scratch smoke, not logged]. max_iter 20,000 is a safety cap. No validation number was computed before this file was fixed.

scoring: the full distribution over V per target: top-1 = argmax with ties to the lowest id, top-5 = rank of the gold token below 5, bits per token of the gold token; every row must sum to one within 1e-9 and its gold entry must equal the sparse formula within 1e-12 (relative)

secondary_rows.s_only: the same pipeline without the document clauses (diagnostic ablation, fitted by the same EM, no threshold)

comparators.recomputed: the left bigram (tmlm.eval.baselines.ngram.left_bigram_top1 on the full train split) and KN-5 both sides (tmlm.cvtm.kn_gpu.fit_kn forward and on the reversed documents, BidirectionalKN.predict with the frozen hidden mask) are recomputed per target; their top-1 must equal the logged values exactly (pipeline checks). CBOW-kNN is not recomputed (its trained model is not stored) and enters as the logged number.

threshold.rule: H8.11 MET iff the masked CVTM's validation top-1 is above the left bigram (true context) AND above CBOW-kNN, both at their exact logged values (0.16876317722028758 and 0.09362044867694785; cited as 0.1687 and 0.0936 in docs/13 A3). KN-5 both sides (0.44190178381067446) is reported with the paired difference; the prediction of beating it is 0.7 (no threshold).

bootstrap.statistics: top-1 of the masked CVTM; paired top-1 differences to the recomputed left bigram, KN-5 both sides and the S-only ablation; top-1 minus the logged CBOW-kNN number
bootstrap.label: derived

compute.memory_note: the counting runs one pattern at a time on the GPU (sort based, about 5 GB of device memory at 135M positions); only the queried contexts come back to the host. The KN-5 comparator fits (forward and backward, about 6.5 GB of host memory each) wait for the memory rule (memory.current + 20 GiB < 0.80 memory.max)

smoke.note: not logged: counts on the first 3M training tokens without the documents of residues 7 and 8, which form a pseudo-evaluation set with a synthetic 15 percent mask (SeedSequence([20260924, 1108, 1])); no validation number is computed
